parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the flow log.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: FlowLogId
parameters.description: The ID of the flow log.

parameters.name: FlowLogName
parameters.description:
The name of the flow log.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: LogStoreName
parameters.description: The name of the Logstore that stores the captured traffic.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in paging query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the project that manages the captured traffic.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the flow log.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the flow log belongs.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource whose traffic you want to capture.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type of the traffic to catch. Valid values:
          
- **NetworkInterface**: network interface controller (NIC).
  
- **VSwitch**: all network interface controllers (NICs) in a vSwitch.
  
- **VPC**: all network interface controllers (NICs) in a virtual private cloud (VPC).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the flow log. Valid values:
- **Active**: the flow log is active.

- **Activating**: the flow log is being created.

- **Inactive**: the flow log is inactive.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: TrafficType
parameters.description:
The traffic type to collect. Valid values:
          
- **All**: all traffic.
  
- **Allow**: traffic allowed by access control.
  
- **Drop**: traffic deny by access control.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC whose flow logs you want to query.
